abstract: BACKGROUND: Ovaries are common site of non-neoplastic and neoplastic lesions. They can present from the neonatal period to post menopause. Most are functional in nature and resolve with minimal treatment. Objective of the study was to determine the nature of various ovarian lesions and to ascertain the frequency and distribution of the various non-neoplastic and neoplastic lesions. METHODS: The study was a retrospective review of all cases of ovarian cancer, benign ovarian neoplasm and functional ovarian cysts received during Jan-Dec 2008 at Chughtai's Lahore Laboratory. The clinical data of the patients was obtained from their respective files. RESULTS: A total of 498 different non-neoplastic and neoplastic lesions were seen during one calendar year 2008. Non-neoplastic cysts were more common (343, 68.87%) than neoplastic tumours (155, 31.12%). The commonest non-neoplastic cyst was luteal cyst followed by follicular cyst. Among the neoplastic tumours 78.70% were benign and 21.29% were malignant. Benign serous cysts were the commonest benign tumour followed by mature cystic teratoma and mucinous cyst. Serous cystadenocarcinoma was the commonest malignant tumour followed closely by endometrioid carcinoma and granulosa cell tumour. Krukenberg tumour, tumour metastatic to ovaries and non-Hodgkins lymphoma was also diagnosed during this period. Malignant germ cell tumours were seen in much younger age group followed by sex cord stromal tumours. Epithelial tumours were seen in much older age group. CONCLUSION: The morphologic diversity of ovarian masses poses many challenges. A specific diagnosis can usually be made by evaluating routinely stained slides but sometimes immunohistochemistry is required in difficult cases. Gross features also provide useful diagnostic clues.
abstract_ja: 背景：卵巣は非腫瘍性および腫瘍性病変の好発部位である。新生児期から閉経後まで発生しうる。大部分は機能性で、最小限の治療で消失する。本研究の目的は、各種の非腫瘍性および腫瘍性病変の性質、ならびにその頻度と分布を明らかにすることであった。方法：2008年1月から12月までにChughtai's Lahore Laboratoryで受理された、すべての卵巣癌、良性卵巣腫瘍、機能性卵巣嚢胞の症例を後方視的に検討した。患者の臨床データはそれぞれのファイルから取得した。結果：2008年の1年間に、非腫瘍性および腫瘍性病変の合計498例が認められた。非腫瘍性嚢胞(343例、68.87%)は腫瘍性腫瘍(155例、31.12%)より多かった。最も多い非腫瘍性嚢胞は黄体嚢胞で、次いで卵胞嚢胞であった。腫瘍性腫瘍のうち78.70%は良性、21.29%は悪性であった。良性腫瘍では漿液性嚢胞が最も多く、次いで成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、粘液性嚢胞であった。悪性腫瘍では漿液性嚢胞腺癌が最も多く、続いて類内膜癌、顆粒膜細胞腫であった。クルーケンベルグ腫瘍、卵巣転移性腫瘍、非ホジキンリンパ腫も診断された。悪性胚細胞腫瘍はより若い年齢層に、性索間質性腫瘍はそれに続いて認められた。上皮性腫瘍はより高齢の年齢層に認められた。結論：卵巣腫瘤の形態学的多様性は多くの課題を提示する。通常の染色標本の評価により特定の診断が可能な場合が多いが、困難な症例では免疫組織化学が必要となることもある。肉眼所見も有用な診断の手がかりを与える。
